prompts.name: freight-yard
prompts.prompt: Create a NEW original story illustration, exact wide2:1. Attached images are identity/style references ONLY, not scenes to copy. Same black-and-white Macintosh adventure/woodcut style, rounded work submarine with compact conning tower, three clean portholes, tail fins and propeller. Real three-dimensional depth: cropped near foreground, overlapping forms, clear near/middle/distant scale, oblique cylindrical surfaces and perspective. Strong solid black shadow masses and broad clean white lit planes, restrained25/50percent ordered surface shading on curved sidewalls only. Chunky recognizable forms for128x64pixels. No people, silhouettes, hands, lettering, labels, UI, captions, borders, watermarks or all-overgrain. Scene: fully SUBMERGED inactive Freight Yard in a deep black cavern. The familiar small worksub, empty deck NO cargo, holds still at left midground, floodlights aimed at a large stalled freight lift and its cable housing to the right. A cropped near foreground steel rail and crossbeam create depth, tall gantry rails descend from dark overhead structure, a freight platform with one crate hangs stranded low beside rock foundations. The cable mechanism is motionless, no working crane, no welcoming service berth or restored lights. Broad light from sub picks out thick sheave housing and gantry posts; dark structure recedes into cavern. No water surface/horizon/reflections. Quiet slow survey hold, not a delivery. Use large simple structures with visible volume, not diagram icons.

prompts.name: ruined-cable
prompts.prompt: Create a NEW original story illustration, exact wide2:1. Attached images are identity/style references ONLY, not scenes to copy. Same black-and-white Macintosh adventure/woodcut style, rounded work submarine with compact conning tower, three clean portholes, tail fins and propeller. Real three-dimensional depth: cropped near foreground, overlapping forms, clear near/middle/distant scale, oblique cylindrical surfaces and perspective. Strong solid black shadow masses and broad clean white lit planes, restrained25/50percent ordered surface shading on curved sidewalls only. Chunky recognizable forms for128x64pixels. No people, silhouettes, hands, lettering, labels, UI, captions, borders, watermarks or all-overgrain. Scene: close underwater inspection of the Freight Yard lift's thick open cable housing, large in left and center frame. Oblique view reveals a big grooved metal sheave inside a deep black chamber, rounded housing thickness and side plates. A thick load-bearing cable passes over the sheave then hangs toward foreground where it is completely PARTED: two visibly separated fat cable ends with a LARGE black gap, each end splitting into just4-5 broad frayed wire bundles. Broken cable should dominate central foreground and remain unmistakable at128x64; no fine hair scratch. Cropped steel beam near lower edge, darker rails recede right into black underwater setting. Off-camera sub floodlight reveals cable strands and heavy metal edges. Inactive and unrepaired. No crate loading, workers, workshop bench, new replacement coil or active service light.

referenceRoles: Prior illustrations are work-sub identity, hydroponic materials and heavy machinery style references; these are new scenes, not replacements.

nativeRendering.method: Balanced v3 integer source-cell RGB area average. Outside threshold +/-40 solid threshold result. Within:25% white below threshold-13;50% below threshold+13;75% otherwise. Ordered2x2 [[0,2],[3,1]].
nativeRendering.rendererRuntime: Node.js built-ins; run from repository root
